//: O2C Timesheet Module — VBCS backend catalogue.
The module is a STANDALONE application, so it has exactly one backend of
its own: the ORDS surface over its own ATP schema. Fusion and OTL are
reached through OIC, never directly from the browser, so they are not
declared here — that keeps Fusion OAuth credentials out of the client
entirely (NFR-005, Security sheet 'No secrets in client').
Replace the url per environment; never commit a PROD URL (Instructions
